verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM does generate AI output from the user's own data inside the product. It offers document chat backed by RAG, where every document joins the agent's knowledge base, plus automatic meeting summaries with action items and key decisions. A hands-on user found answers on regulatory PDFs largely correct, though the citations display was garbled. However, the evidence shows on-demand Q&A and summarization rather than proactive insights or suggestions surfaced from the data, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: documented proactive or automatic insight and suggestion generation across a user's data (beyond chat answers and meeting summaries), reliable source citations for generated insights, and in-depth first-party docs on insight features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Chat with your docs, use AI Agents
Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.
Action items, key decisions, and full transcripts ready the moment you hang up.
answers were largely correct, but the citations window showed somewhat garbled content
